name: Kempegowda International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways, 09L/27R and 09R/27L, each 4,000 m x 45 m

hours.v: air traffic services, fuelling and handling 24 hours; the aerodrome operator's office is Mon-Fri 0300-1200 UTC (08:30-17:30 IST)

fuel.v: Jet A-1 by hydrant, dispensers and bowsers, 24 hours

handling.v: all non-scheduled aircraft get a follow-me service; no hangar space for visiting aircraft
handling.quote: All non-sked aircraft shall be provided with Follow-Me service.

noise.v: pilots should keep reverse thrust after landing to a minimum
noise.quote: Consistent with safety of aircraft operations and in consideration of high intensity runway operations

notes: Read AAI India eAIP AD 2 VOBL, AIRAC AMDT 05-23 effective 10 Aug 2023 (the newest edition found); the current edition could not be located because aim-india.aai.aero (home) and aai.aero pages could not be opened (permission not given / site blocks reading), so status is partial until the current AD 2 VOBL is checked. AD 2.3 gives ATS H24; no curfew or night restriction is stated. AD 2.20 covers the nearby Yelahanka (VOYK) air base and does not mention slots or general aviation.
